title: Rabbah
sourceLines: .A city east of the Jordan River, originally belonging to the Ammonites Jos 13:25
.Bedstead of the giant named Og, kept at De 3:11
.Possessed again by the Ammonites; prophesied against Jer 49:2,3; Eze 21:20; 25:5; Am 1:14
-2. A city in the territory of the tribe of Judah Jos 15:60
